Solve a DIMACS CNF with the certified SAT engine.

The SAT Competition interface as a largo verb: prints `s SATISFIABLE` with a `v` model or `s UNSATISFIABLE`, optionally exporting a DRAT/DPR/SR refutation for external checkers (drat-trim). Exit codes follow the competition convention: 10 = SAT, 20 = UNSAT, 1 = error.

Usage: largo sat [OPTIONS] <FILE>

Arguments:
  <FILE>
          The DIMACS CNF file to solve

Options:
      --proof <PROOF>
          Write the UNSAT certificate here (DRAT; DPR/SR for symmetry routes)

      --stats
          Print solver statistics to stderr

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo sat instance.cnf
  largo sat instance.cnf --proof refutation.drat
  largo sat instance.cnf --stats
